opportunities.title: Hakluyt Society Research Grants

amount.raw: Reimbursements of research expenditure previously agreed with the relevant series editors (source: Harry & Grace Smith Fund). No monetary amount stated.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to anyone; recipients of support need not be members of the Society. Applicants under category A (research in support of preparing a publication proposal for submission) apply in the first instance to the Society's Administrator; applicants under category B (research towards completion of an approved project under contract) discuss in the first instance with the assigned Series Editor.
opportunities.summary: The Hakluyt Society supports research undertaken in preparing publication proposals to be submitted to the Society, or research on proposals already approved where volumes are under contract. Payments are made as reimbursements of previously agreed expenditure from the Society's Harry & Grace Smith Fund, in line with the charitable object of advancing education through publishing records of voyages, travels, naval expeditions and other geographical material. Eligible research may relate to a volume intended for the Society's main series (currently Series III) or for the series Hakluyt Society Studies in the History of Travel.
